title: Senior BI Analyst - Quicksight
description: Job Description We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior BI Analyst to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will possess a strong analytical mindset, business acumen, and technical skillset to transform complex requirements into actionable insights through data discovery, transformation, analysis and dashboard development. A self-starter mindset, and excellent communication and organizational skills are essential, as this role bridges the gap between various stakeholders from business experts to technical teams. This role encompasses also data integration and management in our AWS services, delivering comprehensive training and end-user support on our data solutions, while driving continuous process improvements and maintaining expertise in the latest BI tools, data analytics methodologies, and cloud service innovations. Key Responsibilities Data Analysis and QuickSight Dashboard Development : Partner with business stakeholders, system owners, data analysts, and engineers to understand business requirements and data needs. Discover and transform raw data into meaningful visualizations and insights that align with business objectives. Use QuickSight to analyze large datasets and design an develop interactive visualizations. Deliver comprehensive dashboards that provide valuable business insights and facilitate effective data exploration. Create customized solutions with advanced features and functionality to address specific user needs. Build user-friendly datasets and dashboards by adhering to consistent visualization and data standards for intuitive usage and navigation. Maintain thorough version control and documentation. Configure and maintain advanced access controls, including role-based permissions, data-level security, and privacy compliance. Verify that all security measures align with use cases and policy requirements. Leverage advanced AI capabilities to enhance user experience and deliver additional value through our analytics solutions. Update data pipelines, analytical models, and dashboards to adapt to evolving business needs. Ensure data accuracy, relevance, and optimal pipeline performance. Data Integration And Management Utilize AWS services such as Amazon S3, AWS Glue, and Amazon Redshift to extract, transform, and load (ETL) data from various sources. Design and implement robust data transformation pipelines, enabling reliable insights for our business partners. Work closely with data engineers and cloud architects to ensure seamless integration of data from various source systems into S3 and Redshift. Optimize and management queries for performance and scalability. Identify and address performance bottlenecks to ensure quick processing for up-to-date dashboards. Ensure compliance with data security policies and governance guidelines when handling sensitive data within our cloud infrastructure. Training And Support Become the trusted analytics partner of our business stakeholders. Guide stakeholders through analytical considerations and KPI design principles. Effectively communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences. Create comprehensive documentation and training materials to facilitate knowledge transfer, promote best practices, and enhance data discoverability. Deliver training and support to help end-users and stakeholders effectively interact with and interpret visualizations. Continuous Improvement Offer technical guidance and mentorship to less experienced team members. Identify opportunities for process improvement and automation to enhance efficiency and productivity. Stay updated on the latest advancements in BI, data analytics, and cloud services. Keep up-to-date with the latest data visualization trends, technologies, and best practices to continuously enhance the quality and impact of visualizations. What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications) Bachelor's or Master's degree in a related field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics). Minimum of 3 years of experience in data analysis or a related field. Strong proficiency in SQL for data querying, data transformation and manipulation, and Python Experience working with data visualization tools, specifically Amazon QuickSight. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, as well as attention to detail. Self-motivated and able to work independently, in a team-oriented environment. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills and ability to work independently without the need for directions. Proven in-depth experience working with various data sources, databases and data integration, with large datasets and design efficient data models for data visualization tools, specifically Amazon QuickSight. What Will Give You A Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications) Experience with statictical/machine learning techniques is a strong plus. Creative mindset with a keen eye for design and aesthetics. Knowledge of data visualization best practices and principles. Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure) and best practices Experience with cloud-based software development tools and methodologies (Git, CI/CD, Code Deploy, Code Pipeline, etc.) is a plus. Working knowledge of AWS command-line interface (CLI) or SDKs for programmatic access. AWS Lambda / Server-less computing

title: Solution Architect – Order to Cash (O2C) & Procure to Pay (P2P) (m/f/d)
description: Company Description We are REPA Deutschland GmbH , part of the REPA Group - Europe's leading distributor of spare parts for the catering industry, commercial kitchens, refrigeration technology and more. With over 95,000 items from more than 2,000 manufacturers, we offer the largest range on the market. Our 6 warehouses in Europe, 9 locations and over 1,000 employees guarantee fast and reliable service. Our affiliation with Parts Town , the American market leader in high-tech spare parts distribution, gives us even more power. Together we ensure that everything runs smoothly - whether it's a coffee machine, refrigerator or combi-steamer. We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect to design and implement enterprise scalable solutions for business processes including Order to Cash (O2C) and Procure to Pay (P2P). The role requires expertise in system architecture, technical understanding business process optimization, and cross-system integration to ensure seamless end-to-end workflows across enterprise platforms including ERP, e-commerce, logistics and other solutions. Job Description Solution Architecture & Design Develop and maintain a comprehensive business and technical architecture for cross-stream business processes, ensuring scalability, performance, and security. Design system integrations between our legacy ERPs like Navision ERP and SAGE X3, future Enterprise scale ERP system, legacy web shops, SAP Commerce Cloud, and multiple WMS platforms to enable seamless data flow and process automation. Contribute and enforce architectural standards, best practices, and governance processes. Business Process Alignment Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand their requirements and align system designs with business objectives. Analyse current processes for inefficiencies and propose architectural solutions to improve them. Technical Leadership & Strategy Act as the subject matter expert (SME) for business solution areas, providing technical guidance to internal teams and external vendors. Define the long-term architectural roadmap for the integration of ERP, e-commerce, and logistics platforms. System Integration Lead the design and implementation of APIs, middleware, and other integration technologies to ensure seamless connectivity between systems. Ensure data consistency, integrity, and security across integrated platforms. Project Delivery & Oversight Oversee the delivery of solution implementations, ensuring alignment with the architecture. Collaborate with project managers, developers, and analysts to ensure timely and successful delivery. Technology Evaluation & Innovation Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend innovative solutions to enhance the O2C and P2P processes. Propose strategies for system scalability and cloud expansion. Documentation & Knowledge Sharing Create and maintain technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, data flow models, and integration specifications. Provide mentorship and knowledge transfer to internal teams. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree, preferably master’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related field. Strong expertise in business processes, including order management, invoicing, procurement, inventory, and fulfilment workflows. In-depth knowledge of SAP Commerce Cloud, Enterprise scale ERP and WMS platforms, with experience in integrating multiple systems in a distribution focused business. Proficiency in designing and implementing enterprise architectures using APIs, microservices, and middleware platforms. Hands-on experience with integration tools and platforms (e.g., Dell Boomi, MuleSoft, or similar). Strong understanding of data flows, ETL processes, and system security best practices. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on delivering scalable solutions. Ability to travel to EU locations as required. 9+ years of demonstrated experience in solution architecture, with a focus on ERP, e-commerce, and/or logistics systems. Excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills. Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., Azure) and DevOps practices is a plus. Knowledge of Agile methodologies and project management tools. Relevant certifications (e.g., TOGAF, SAP Commerce Cloud, or ERP-specific certifications) are a plus. title: Senior ML Data Engineer
description: This fast-growing, well-funded health-tech company is on a mission to transform how clinicians understand and treat complex diseases. By combining advanced multimodal AI with real-world clinical data, they are building next-generation tools to help medical professionals see the full picture of a patient’s condition — from imaging to genomics to treatment history. Working in close collaboration with leading hospitals and research institutes across Europe, the company has doubled in size over the past year to 80+ team members from more than 25 nationalities, with offices in Zurich and Amsterdam. About the Role As a Senior Data Engineer , you’ll be at the heart of building large-scale, high-quality datasets that power state-of-the-art foundation models for healthcare. You’ll design and implement advanced data pipelines for sourcing, generating, and curating complex multimodal datasets at massive scale. You will: Build high-throughput pipelines to ingest multimodal data at petabyte scale. Develop systems for synthetic data generation to enhance model training. Create filtering and rating systems for topic relevance, quality, and compliance. Partner closely with ML researchers to steer the development of cutting-edge AI models. What We’re Looking For Essential Skills & Experience Excellent Python programming skills. Strong experience with distributed computing frameworks (Ray, Spark, or similar). Proven track record in designing and operating large-scale data pipelines.
